statements.impact_statement: Production Linux AMD64 and ARM64 builds do not import golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp or any of its subpackages, directly or transitively. OpenPGP verification uses github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto/openpgp. The x/crypto module remains necessary for bcrypt and other cryptographic primitives. This assessment applies to production builds checked by scripts/check-no-legacy-openpgp.sh; CI and release workflows enforce that guard. Reassess before changing the module version, supported platforms, build tags, or dependency policy.
statements.status_notes: Dependency guard: https://github.com/linsomniac/apt-cacher-ultra/blob/main/scripts/check-no-legacy-openpgp.sh. The independent govulncheck CI gate remains enabled without suppressions. Scanner usage: https://github.com/linsomniac/apt-cacher-ultra/blob/main/docker/README.md#vulnerability-scanning.
